messages:
ellie (security): Heads up — AP-SOUTH egress baseline changes landing tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Might block bootstrap paths used by our GPU onboarding.

harold (platform): Which flows? We should know impact on reserved GPU pool provisioning vs spot onboarding.

mike (infra): Quick grep: nodes call `keystore.ap.redwood:443`, `bootstrap-legacy.ap-south.redwood`, and a metrics sink on 13.59.144.0/22. Staging showed `keystore: TLS handshake timed out` when egress tightened.

tara (sre): Observed warm-pool fill drop from 82% -> 47% in staging when that sink was blocked. Cold-start latency tail increased ~120ms per request due to cache fallback.

ellie (security): Compliance will only allow a scoped exception if we provide a strict allowlist, a 24h timebox, and extended audit retention for those flows. Also need an owner and rollback plan.

harold (platform): Proposal: allow `keystore.ap.redwood:443`, `bootstrap-legacy.ap-south:443`, and `13.59.144.0/22` for 24h. We'll canary by AZ and limit to the reserved onboarding job. I'll open ACL PR and attach justifications.

mike (infra): Canaries: one AZ at a time, 5 nodes max. Script to enable: `./ops/onboard --region ap-south --az b --canary 5`. Smoke test: `curl -sSf https://keystore.ap.redwood/health`.

tara (sre): Rollback criteria: warm-pool fill delta >20% or keystore 5xx rate >0.8% sustained 5m. If triggered, revoke exception immediately and pause backfills.

ellie (security): Good. audit-bot: create ticket with ACL PR link, approvers, retention change, and owner.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-AP-2026-17 "Scoped egress exception for AP-SOUTH GPU onboarding" assigned to ellie (security), harold (platform). PR: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1268

harold (platform): One more ask — cost note: if onboarding stalls we may use on-demand GPUs in other regions for critical customer jobs. That could bump spend ~15% over next 48h. Recording the tradeoff in the ticket.

ellie (security): Approved for 24h. Require post-mortem with remediation plan (proxy routing + deprecate bootstrap-legacy) within next sprint. Remove exception ASAP.

mike (infra): Merging PR and starting AZ canary now. Will post quick metric pings.

tara (sre): I'll watch the channel and alert on the rollback criteria. Ping me for manual rollbacks.
